name: @gotocva/digital-signature
author: sivabharathy <gotocva@gmail.com>
description: A lightweight and efficient Node.js library for generating and managing digital signatures using elliptic curve cryptography (secp256k1). This library provides an easy-to-use interface for securely generating key pairs, signing data, verifying signatures, and validating public keys. It is ideal for use in blockchain applications, cryptographic systems, and secure communication protocols.
